patent.title: List scrolling and document translation, scaling, and rotation on a touch-screen display
patent.family_note: Claim-focused Rights Control replication. Claim 19 was the asserted claim and was confirmed in the second reexamination.

knowledge_origin.description: This replication does not reconstruct the complete original R&D genealogy.

technology.problem: Provide intuitive touchscreen feedback when a user scrolls beyond the edge of an electronic document.
technology.mechanism: The asserted claim covers displaying an area beyond a document edge and translating the document back when touch input ends.

patent.title: Application programming interfaces for scrolling operations

technology.problem: Differentiate single-touch scrolling from multi-touch gesture operations on a touchscreen device.
technology.mechanism: Claim 8 covers event-object based distinction between a single input interpreted as scrolling and two or more input points interpreted as a gesture.
